heroHeadline: 1.5 Million Years of Human Presence in the Southern Levant
heroSubtitle: From Acheulean hominids at Ubeidiya through Bronze Age Canaan, Iron Age Israelite kingdoms, and two millennia of empires and faiths — 2025 archaeological breakthroughs include Jerusalem's first Assyrian cuneiform inscription near the Temple Mount and AI-assisted Dead Sea Scrolls dating that pushes key texts back 150 years.
footerNote: Data sourced from peer-reviewed archaeology (IAA, Hebrew University, Tel Aviv University), UNESCO, British Museum, and major academic institutions. Contested historical interpretations are presented with multiple scholarly perspectives.
